title: HMS Kurdistan hardware abstraction layer (HAL) contract, version 1: one call exchange
description: One HAL call as a contract fixture: the request the web app sends, the typed result the Tauri shell returns ({ok, value | error, auditId}), the events of a subscription, and the local audit record the call produced. The request, value, event, error and audit-record definitions under $defs are the contract that frontend/packages/hal-client and the shell's hal-core implement (BUILD-PROMPT.md §12.8, §13.5; docs/specs/hal/README.md). Every object is closed, so no field outside the contract can carry data.

fixture.description: The fixture name: <call>.<ok or error kind>, with an optional .<reason> suffix where a call has more than one fixture of a kind; equal to the file name without .json.

provenance.description: Every fixture is synthetic data, NOT FOR CLINICAL USE (§18.10).

eventAudits.description: The audit record of each subscription event, in the order of events.

text.description: Text with at least one visible character.

uuid7.description: A UUIDv7 in lower-case canonical form (BUILD-PROMPT.md §7: UUIDv7 identifiers).

auditId.description: Identifier of the audit record written for this call (README.md, "Audit").

utcTimestamp.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with the Z suffix.

sha256.description: Lower-case hexadecimal SHA-256 of the bytes the shell holds.

blobRef.description: A handle to bytes held by the shell for this session (a scan, photo or signature). The web app reads the bytes through the shell and uploads them to the cell; the shell never writes them to a user folder or a device gallery (§9.4) and deletes them when the session ends.

opaqueId.description: An opaque identifier of a device, printer, terminal, workstation, template or session. Never a patient identifier.

messageKey.description: A message key of the @hms/i18n catalogues (frontend/packages/i18n/README.md). The UI shows the catalogue text; the HAL carries no display text.

decimalAmount.description: A non-negative decimal amount as a string. Neither the HAL nor the web app does arithmetic on it.

error.description: A typed error. It carries no free text, no device output and no patient data.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the same call may succeed without a change of configuration. False whenever outcomeUnknown is true.

outcomeUnknown.description: True when the device may already have acted (a print job printed, a card charged): a timeout or device error on a print or payment call. The screen then asks the user to check the device (hal.error.outcomeUnknown) and never repeats the call on its own; a reprint is a new, explicit request that names the earlier job (reprintOf).

result.description: What every HAL call returns: {ok: true, value, auditId} or {ok: false, error, auditId}.

printLabelRequest.description: A label already rendered for the target printer (ZPL text or PDF) by the renderer of WP-0.8; the template id and version go into the audit record and PrintJobCompleted (§12.8).

reprintOf.description: Present only on an explicit reprint: the jobId of the earlier job, so a reprint (of a wristband above all) is a deliberate, audited request and never an automatic retry.

status.description: sent: the printer accepted the job; completed: the printer reported it printed.

printRawRequest.description: Raw bytes for a raw-port printer. Raw print is a capability granted per workstation profile and role (§13.5).

printDocumentRequest.description: A rendered PDF document for a spooled document printer.

reprintOf.description: Present only on an explicit reprint: the jobId of the earlier job, so a reprint (of a wristband above all) is a deliberate, audited request and never an automatic retry.

subscribeRequest.description: Subscribe to events from one device, or from every permitted device of the class when deviceId is absent. The shell delivers a barcode read only to the subscriptions of the window that has the focus when the read arrives; a badge tap goes to every window of the shell, because a change of user clears every window's patient context (docs/specs/hal/README.md, "Windows and patients").

subscriptionValue.description: The subscription handle. Each event carries its own audit ID; closing the subscription is a local unlisten, not a HAL call.

aimId.description: The AIM symbology identifier when the scanner sends it.

data.description: The decoded data exactly as read, with GS1 FNC1 sent as the group separator U+001D (§12.8: scanners preserve GS1 FNC1/GS).

type.description: The document technologies of §9.1 and §11.2. Card formats are open question Q-K12; parsing belongs to card-format plug-ins outside the HAL.

idReadValue.description: The raw document read. hal.id.read returns unavailable (not-implemented) until the ID-card and MRZ reader simulators of WP-1.2 exist (§3.7).

raw.description: The raw barcode data or MRZ lines (newline-separated), unparsed.

mrzCheckDigitsValid.description: MRZ only: whether every ICAO 9303 check digit matched.

badgeEvent.description: One badge tap, after the shell has run the step-up. The raw badge credential stays in the shell.

outcome.description: The result of the Keycloak step-up that the shell ran for this tap, bound to the workstation certificate (§12.8). A refusal does not say why (unknown badge, revoked, identity provider unreachable), so the event does not disclose the policy.

stepUpRef.description: Present only when the step-up completed: an opaque, single-use, short-lived reference to that step-up, which the cell accepts once and only for this workstation [P]; WP-0.4 designs its redemption for the session swap. It is not the badge credential: the badge credential never crosses the bridge. Never logged, never stored.

signCaptureRequest.description: Capture an on-glass handwritten signature image. It is not the electronic signature of the sign and co-sign pattern, which is authenticated by the Trust Plane.

reference.description: The payment reference from the cashiering module; never a patient identifier.

payRequestValue.description: No card PAN, masked or not, and no card data ever reaches the HMS (§12.8); the closed object has no field for it. hal.pay.request returns unavailable (not-implemented) until the card-terminal simulator of WP-1.9 exists (§3.7).

outcome.description: A declined payment is a result, not an error.

permitted.description: Granted to this workstation profile and user (§13.5).

capabilitiesValue.description: What is attached, healthy and permitted for this workstation profile and user (§12.8).

simulated.description: True when every device is simulated (development and test builds).

auditRecord.description: The local audit record of one call or event. A closed allowlist of fields with no PHI (H13, SI-20): no patient identifier or name, no label, document or barcode content, no image or signature, no ID-document data, no badge credential and no payment amount or reference.

writtenBy.description: hal-client writes the record only when no shell is present (outcome error, reason no-shell).

event.description: Absent or call for a call; the event kind for a subscription event (barcode-read only for hal.scan.onBarcode, badge-tap only for hal.auth.onBadge).

sessionRef.description: Opaque reference to the staff session; null before sign-in.
